title: Config Change Sentinel: staged apply, cost-aware aborts, and state harmonizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Config Change Sentinel that performs staged config applies with preflight simulation, warmed canaries, and cost-aware abort/undo triggers. The sentinel should coordinate prefix-level KV cache quarantine/warmup, batching parameter changes, and a state reconciliation step that can safely harmonize the serving runtime after an interrupted apply. The feature aims to reduce cost-regression blast radius from configuration changes (batch sizes, cache TTLs, kernel selection hints) and automate safe undo when economic or quality SLOs are violated.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight simulation produces an estimated cost delta and SLO impact for a proposed config change and surfaces highest-risk keys
Staged apply path: (1) dry-run -> (2) shadow canary with traffic mirroring -> (3) warmup window -> (4) gradual cutover with telemetry gating
Automatic abort/undo triggers include: >25% per-token cost increase for 10m, 3x baseline latency p95 degradation for 5m, or >2% user-facing error rate increase for 5m (configurable thresholds)
State reconciliation recovers KV cache consistency for prefixes that were quarantined during canary without full cluster restart
A recommended 'safe-batch' suggestion list is generated for batching/cache changes with instructions to pre-warm and expected cost impact
All changes and automatic actions are logged and surfaced to Console with links to the exact config diff and runbook
design_decisions: Use a two-tier trigger model: fast behavioral triggers (latency/error) with short windows, and economic triggers (token-cost) with longer windows and hysteresis to avoid churn
Implement prefix-level KV cache quarantine: isolate changed prefixes, run warmup requests in shadow mode, then merge KV state to live to avoid cold-start spikes
Prefer 'soft abort' where traffic is redirected to a fallback model variant or lower batch size rather than immediate global revert to limit user impact
Keep the sentinel stateless where possible and rely on durable snapshots for apply checkpoints to enable multi-controller reconciliation
Expose tuning knobs via Console: thresholds, warmup windows, canary size, and rollback strategy (immediate revert vs. degrade-to-fallback)
Integrate with existing rollout API so Dedicated/private deployments respect tenant isolation and can honor local KMS/HSM constraints
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): preflight estimator + telemetry hooks for per-route cost and latency, basic dry-run UI
Phase 2 (2 sprints): staged apply orchestration, shadow canary plumbing, KV prefix quarantine/warmup primitives
Phase 3 (1 sprint): trigger engine for economic/behavioral aborts, soft-abort fallback flows, and reconciliation worker
Phase 4 (1 sprint): Console UX for recommendations, runbook links, and audit logging; add e2e tests and chaos scenarios
Deliverables: API endpoints, controller, reconciliation worker, console views, test harnesses, and runbooks
test_plan: Unit tests for preflight estimator with synthetic workloads and historical telemetry replay
Integration tests: staged apply flow against local dev cluster with synthetic traffic mirroring
Load tests: verify KV prefix warmup prevents p95 spikes under realistic replayed traffic
Failure injection: simulate partial apply, controller crash, and ensure reconciliation worker converges to safe state
Canary experiment: roll out to internal infra with 5% traffic for two weeks and measure false positive/negative rate
rollout_plan: Alpha: feature flag gated on staging for Platform team (2 weeks)
Beta: enable for internal services and small subset of customer traffic with manual ops oversight (4 weeks)
GA: enable automatic aborts with conservative defaults and option for tenants to opt-in to aggressive thresholds
Post-GA: iterate on recommendation heuristics and add ML-driven anomaly detection for more precise economic triggers
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy triggers may cause oscillation and frequent rollbacks -> Mitigation: implement hysteresis windows, minimum time between automatic actions, and operator cooldowns
Risk: KV state corruption during merge -> Mitigation: use snapshot-and-merge with checksum validation and safe rollback snapshot
Risk: cost estimator inaccuracy -> Mitigation: calibrate estimator with historical billing data and conservative bias; surface confidence score
Risk: tenants with strict isolation (Private) may require on-prem reconciliation -> Mitigation: add tenant-local reconciliation plugin and require explicit approval for destructive ops
